questions.question: Moses set aside three cities where a man could flee after killing someone by accident. These cities were west of the Jordan. True or false?
Moses set aside three cities of refuge. Which kind of man could flee to one of them after killing his neighbor?

answers.text: One who did it by accident with no grudge
One who planned it for weeks ahead
One who did it to take the man's land
